verdict.rationale: Turso docs explicitly state native vector search support with no extensions required, storing embeddings alongside relational data and built-in distance functions for similarity search, and this is corroborated by independent community testimony noting native vector embedding support as a differentiator versus fragile SQLite extensions. Additional docs show vector search used in real agent-memory use cases. missing for 10: deeper independent benchmarking/production-scale validation of vector search performance, and community feedback notes documentation on vector embeddings could be more robust.
